full_name: Stochastic Conditional Gradient Sliding Method for Smooth Convex Optimization
source_reference: Lan, First-order and Stochastic Optimization Methods for Machine Learning, Springer 2020 (Theorem 7.11)

problem.description: Smooth convex optimization over a compact convex set

variable_space.math: X \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n \text{ convex compact}; \; f : X \to \mathbb{R} \text{ closed convex}

assumptions.name: L-smoothness
assumptions.math: f(y) \le l_f(x, y) + \frac{L}{2}\|y - x\|^2, \quad \forall x, y \in X

parameters.name: \operatorname{CndG}(g, u, \beta, \eta)
parameters.math: \text{CndG subroutine: set } u_1 = u, \text{ compute } V_{g,u,\beta}(u_t) := \max_{x \in X} \langle g + \beta(u_t - u), u_t - x \rangle; \text{ if } V_{g,u,\beta}(u_t) \le \eta, \text{ return } u^+ = u_t; \text{ else } u_{t+1} = (1 - \alpha_t) u_t + \alpha_t v_t \text{ with } \alpha_t = \min\left\{1, \frac{\langle \beta(u - u_t) - g, v_t - u_t \rangle}{\beta \|v_t - u_t\|^2}\right\}

main_theorem.rate: O(1/k^2) \text{ in outer iterations; } O\left(\sqrt{L \bar{D}_X^2 / \varepsilon} + \sigma^2 \bar{D}_X^2 / \varepsilon^2\right) \text{ SFO and } O(L \bar{D}_X^2 / \varepsilon) \text{ LO complexity}

proof.description: Start from the deterministic CGS descent relations (7.2.16)-(7.2.17) with exact gradient replaced by the noisy batch estimator g_k, writing g_k = f'(z_k) + delta_k
proof.math: f(y_k) \le (1 - \gamma_k) f(y_{k-1}) + \gamma_k f(x) + \frac{\beta_k \gamma_k}{2} [\|x_{k-1} - x\|^2 - \|x_k - x\|^2] + \eta_k \gamma_k + \gamma_k \langle \delta_k, x - x_{k-1} \rangle + \frac{\gamma_k \|\delta_k\|_*^2}{2(\beta_k - L\gamma_k)}, \; \forall x \in X

proof.description: Subtract f(x) from both sides and apply Lemma 3.17 with w_k = gamma_k and W_k = Gamma_k to telescope the weighted recursion
proof.math: f(y_k) - f(x) \le \frac{\beta_k \gamma_k}{2} \bar{D}_X^2 + \Gamma_k \sum_{i=1}^{k} \frac{\eta_i \gamma_i}{\Gamma_i} + \Gamma_k \sum_{i=1}^{k} \frac{\gamma_i}{\Gamma_i} \left[ \sum_{j=1}^{B_i} B_i^{-1} \langle \delta_{i,j}, x - x_{i-1} \rangle + \frac{\|\delta_i\|_*^2}{2(\beta_i - L\gamma_i)} \right]

proof.description: Take expectation: the martingale terms vanish since E[<delta_{i,j}, x^* - x_{i-1}>] = 0 because delta_{i,j} are independent of x_{i-1}; apply the batch variance bound E[||delta_i||_*^2] <= sigma^2/B_i
For part (c), the inner CndG procedure is deterministic (only the gradient input differs), so the inner-iteration bound from Theorem 7.9(c) applies directly

key_lemmas.name: Batch estimator unbiasedness and variance
key_lemmas.role: Bounds the variance of the mini-batch gradient estimator used in the stochastic CGS method

proof.description: Let S_{B_k} = sum_{j=1}^{B_k} (G(z_k, xi_{k,j}) - f'(z_k)) and expand E[||S_{B_k}||_*^2] recursively using independence of the fresh batch samples
Since g_k - f'(z_k) = B_k^{-1} S_{B_k}, divide by B_k^2 to obtain the variance bound

key_lemmas.name: One-step stochastic CGS recursion
key_lemmas.statement_math: f(y_k) \le (1 - \gamma_k) f(y_{k-1}) + \gamma_k f(x) + \frac{\beta_k \gamma_k}{2} \left[ \|x_{k-1} - x\|^2 - \|x_k - x\|^2 \right] + \eta_k \gamma_k + \gamma_k \langle \delta_k, x - x_{k-1} \rangle + \frac{\gamma_k \|\delta_k\|_*^2}{2(\beta_k - L\gamma_k)}, \quad \forall x \in X
key_lemmas.role: Provides the per-step descent relation for the stochastic CGS method by perturbing the deterministic CGS inequality with the estimator noise

proof.description: Start from the deterministic CGS relations (7.2.16) and (7.2.17) with f'(z_k) replaced by g_k = f'(z_k) + delta_k
proof.math: f(y_k) \le (1 - \gamma_k) f(y_{k-1}) + \gamma_k l_f(z_k, x_k) + \frac{\beta_k \gamma_k}{2} [\|x_{k-1} - x\|^2 - \|x_k - x\|^2] + \eta_k \gamma_k + \gamma_k \langle \delta_k, x - x_k \rangle

proof.description: Apply the completion-of-squares bound to the noise cross-term: <delta_k, x - x_k> - (1/2)(beta_k - L gamma_k)||x_k - x_{k-1}||^2 <= <delta_k, x - x_{k-1}> + ||delta_k||_*^2 / (2(beta_k - L gamma_k))
proof.math: \langle \delta_k, x - x_k \rangle - \frac{1}{2}(\beta_k - L\gamma_k)\|x_k - x_{k-1}\|^2 \le \langle \delta_k, x - x_{k-1} \rangle + \frac{\|\delta_k\|_*^2}{2(\beta_k - L\gamma_k)}

proof.description: Collect all terms to obtain the one-step recursion valid for every comparison point x in X
proof.math: f(y_k) \le (1 - \gamma_k) f(y_{k-1}) + \gamma_k f(x) + \frac{\beta_k \gamma_k}{2} [\|x_{k-1} - x\|^2 - \|x_k - x\|^2] + \eta_k \gamma_k + \gamma_k \langle \delta_k, x - x_{k-1} \rangle + \frac{\gamma_k \|\delta_k\|_*^2}{2(\beta_k - L\gamma_k)}

key_lemmas.name: Weighted recursion lemma (Lemma 3.17)
key_lemmas.statement_math: \text{Let } w_k \in (0,1], \; W_k := \begin{cases} 1, & k = 1, \\ (1 - w_k) W_{k-1}, & k \ge 2. \end{cases} \text{ If } \delta_k \le (1 - w_k) \delta_{k-1} + B_k, \; k = 1, 2, \ldots, \text{ then } \delta_k \le W_k (1 - w_1) \delta_0 + W_k \sum_{i=1}^{k} \frac{B_i}{W_i}.
key_lemmas.role: Converts the one-step stochastic CGS recursion into a weighted telescoping sum with Gamma_k

proof.description: Divide the one-step recursion by W_k so the coefficient on delta_{k-1} becomes exactly 1/W_{k-1}
Sum the resulting inequalities over i = 1, ..., k to telescope the weighted left-hand side

key_lemmas.name: CndG inner-iteration bound (Theorem 7.9(c))
key_lemmas.role: Bounds the number of inner linear-optimization oracle calls at each outer iteration of the CndG subroutine

proof.description: Define lambda_t := 2/t and Lambda_t := 1/(t(t-1)) for the CndG inner iterations, and bound the Wolfe gap phi(u_{t+1}) - phi^* via the recursion (7.2.24)-(7.2.25)
Show that min_{j=1,...,t} V_{g,u,beta}(u_j) <= 6 beta D_X^2 / (t+1) using the telescoped weighted sum of gap values
